description: This PHP source file defines the LegacyMPDFEngine class, which extends the PDFEngine class and provides methods to generate PDF documents using the mPDF library within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for writing HTML content, headers, and footers, configuring PDF settings, and outputting the final PDF.

classes.name: LegacyMPDFEngine
classes.description: A class that wraps around the mPDF library to facilitate PDF generation within SuiteCRM, providing methods to write HTML content, headers, footers, add pages, and configure PDF settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mPDF instance, optionally accepting an external mPDF object.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Writes HTML content to the PDF, handling different sections such as headers and body.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a specified destination and filename.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTML header content for the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Sets the HTML footer content for the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Adds CSS styling to the PDF content.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Adds a blank page to the PDF document.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Configures PDF generation settings based on options loaded from a configuration file.
